reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: A great gel mask. Definitely brightened my skin, and didn’t irritate my dermatitis.
reviews.zh: 好好用嘅 gel mask。皮膚明顯提亮咗，而且冇刺激到我嘅濕疹。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: Bought this for my friend. She likes it very much. Her skin feels much more hydrated and plump after use. However, she didn't see big brightening effect after one use.
reviews.zh: 買俾朋友嘅。佢好鍾意。用完之後皮膚感覺更加保濕同飽滿。不過，用咗一次之後佢覺得提亮效果唔算好明顯。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: An absolute repeat order! It adheres to my skin nicely and it makes my skin soft and brightened afterwards
reviews.zh: 絕對係回購！貼住皮膚好貼，用完之後皮膚變得柔軟同有提亮效果。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text:
Repurchased.
Very floppy packaging and super slippery at first but tried it overnight and woke up with such a nice inner glow from the skin while skin feeling well hydrated.
reviews.zh:
回購。
包裝非常軟趴趴，開頭亦都好滑，但係試過敷過夜，第二朝醒嚟皮膚有種好好嘅內在水光感，同時皮膚感覺好保濕。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: I tried it and slept in it. My skin before was really red because of my acne before but when I woke up my skin was glowy and bright. It made my acne look not that noticeable. It was hard to put on at first because it kept slipping off but once it’s on it is comfortable to sleep in.
reviews.zh: 我試過敷住瞓。之前皮膚因為暗瘡好紅，但係醒嚟嘅時候皮膚有光澤又明亮咗，睇落暗瘡冇之前咁顯眼。開頭好難戴上去，因為成日滑走，但係一戴好之後瞓覺都好舒服。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text:
ズレるけどひんやりしてて良い。

首のゲルまであるのが特徴
マスク外れやすいのでやはり固定されるまでは横になって待つのがいいです。

香りは原料のココナッツみたいな甘い感じの匂いしてます。。強くはないけどいい匂いではないかな。

ひんやり肌を冷やしてくれるので良いです。
もう一種類も気になります。
reviews.zh:
會滑但係涼涼哋都唔錯。
特點係連頸都有 gel。
Mask 容易甩，所以未貼穩之前最好瞓低等佢定。
味道似原材料嘅椰子嗰種甜味。。唔算濃，但係我覺得唔算好聞。
涼涼哋可以幫皮膚降溫，唔錯。
仲有留意緊另一款。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text:
Repurchased.
super slippery at first but after using overnight you wake up with such a nice inner glow from the skin while skin feeling well hydrated. Has an extra sheet piece for the neck aswell.
reviews.zh:
回購。
開頭非常滑，但係敷過夜之後，第二朝醒嚟皮膚有種好好嘅內在水光感，同時皮膚好保濕。仲有一塊額外嘅頸用 sheet。

reviews.shade: goodal Green Tangerine Vita-C Dark Spot Care Gel Mask Sheet 1ea
reviews.text: I couldn't believe how soft this mask left my skin. And the glow, wow. See the results for yourself on YouTube or TikTok at Éva Shoshanna1.
reviews.zh: 呢個 mask 用完之後皮膚軟到難以置信。仲有嗰個光澤，wow。可以去 YouTube 或者 TikTok 嘅 Éva Shoshanna1 自己睇效果。
